serverInfo.name: thinkinglabs-mcp
serverInfo.title: thinkinglabs MCP server
serverInfo.description: Personal thinking surface and structured public operating layer. Exposes read-only views, atomic claims, thoughts, predictions, and curation tools.

tools.name: query_view
tools.title: Query public view
tools.description: Filter one public view by free text, tags, and limit.

tools.name: contact.precheck
tools.title: Precheck contact intent
tools.description: Check a proposed inquiry against the public contact policy before sending.

tools.name: contact.send
tools.title: Prepare contact handoff
tools.description: Validate a message and return the public email handoff. The server does not send mail.

tools.name: subscribe_brain_diff
tools.title: Subscribe to brain diff
tools.description: Return public feed URLs and optionally recent deterministic entries from git history.

tools.name: question.submit
tools.title: Submit answer to open question
tools.description: Write a structured reader answer into the submissions queue for later triage.
